class.name: litearm_vr_teleop/VrForwardController
class.description:
Forward controller for teleoperated position setpoints: a stream of seven joint positions on ~/commands is passed to the hardware interfaces with no trajectory and no goal.
It derives from forward_command_controller::ForwardControllersBase, and it has to override update() because of a property of this arm: the firmware reads the velocity field of the command frame as the slew ceiling of the position reference, so a controller that writes position alone leaves the velocity interface at zero, which freezes the reference and produces an arm that accepts commands without moving. Each written position therefore carries a velocity derived from the setpoint stream, bounded by max_velocity.
On a stale command (command_timeout_s) or before the first command it holds at the measured position with zero velocity, which on this firmware is the only true hold.
